fullPassage: A sport ecosystem exists based on the type and rate of coopetition existing. Coopetition is defined as "the simultaneous pursuit of cooperation and competition among firms to leverage strategically important resources for superior value creation purposes". It is a useful way to understand the dynamic nature of sport businesses which need to collaborate for resource efficiency purposes but potentially compete with each other. This special relationship should be managed properly due to trust and confidence issues being paramount. It can be challenging to be collaborative and competitive in sport as they involve different forms of behaviour. This means a careful balancing act may be required in terms of the amount of emphasis placed on each activity. Often sport managers will try to be more competitive due to performance reasons and less collaborative. By necessity they may need to share information but do so in a cautious manner. This means it might be better to have plans in place about how to pursue both simultaneously. This will ensure one is not neglected at the expense of the other.

questions.passage: A sport ecosystem exists based on the type and rate of coopetition existing. Coopetition is defined as "the simultaneous pursuit of cooperation and competition among firms to leverage strategically important resources for superior value creation purposes". It is a useful way to understand the dynamic nature of sport businesses which need to collaborate for resource efficiency purposes but potentially compete with each other. This special relationship should be managed properly due to trust and confidence issues being paramount. It can be challenging to be collaborative and competitive in sport as they involve different forms of behaviour. This means a careful balancing act may be required in terms of the amount of emphasis placed on each activity. Often sport managers will try to be more competitive due to performance reasons and less collaborative. By necessity they may need to share information but do so in a cautious manner. This means it might be better to have plans in place about how to pursue both simultaneously. This will ensure one is not neglected at the expense of the other.
questions.stem:
윗글에서 코피티션이 존재하는 기반이 되는 두 가지 요소를 영어로 쓰시오.

"the __________ and __________ of coopetition"

det.ref:
[원문] based on the type and rate of coopetition existing
[해석] 존재하는 코피티션의 유형과 비율에 기반하여
det.correct: type, rate: 유형(type)과 비율(rate). 코피티션의 두 가지 기반 요소.
det.tip: type(유형)과 rate(비율/정도) — 코피티션의 종류와 정도에 따라 스포츠 생태계가 존재.

questions.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 스포츠 산업에서는 협력과 경쟁 사이의 균형 잡힌 접근이 요구된다.
스포츠 매니저는 항상 경쟁을 최우선으로 해야 한다.
정보 공유는 스포츠 사업의 성공에 전혀 기여하지 않는다.

det.ref: [원문 핵심] a careful balancing act may be required / ensure one is not neglected at the expense of the other
det.correct: ① 협력과 경쟁 사이의 균형 잡힌 접근이 요구된다: 글의 핵심 주제와 일치.
wrongs: ② 경쟁만 우선은 글의 결론과 반대 — 균형이 핵심
③ 정보 공유가 기여하지 않는다는 내용 없음
④ 'among firms'라고 했으므로 스포츠에만 한정되지 않음
det.tip: 주제 = 코피티션에서 협력과 경쟁의 '균형(balancing act)'이 핵심.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref:
[원문] how to pursue both simultaneously
[해석] 둘 다 동시에 추구하는 방법
det.correct: ③ pursue: 추구하다, 원문 일치. 협력과 경쟁 둘 다를 동시에 추구.
wrongs: ① abandon: 포기하다, 반의어
② separate: 분리하다, 다름
④ dominate: 지배하다, 다름
det.tip: pursue(추구하다) = seek = go after. 협력과 경쟁 '둘 다' 추구하는 것이 핵심.
